idea-plugin.name: MyCPAssistant
idea-plugin.description:
MyCPAssistant is a powerful, modern, and lightweight competitive programming companion plugin for IntelliJ IDEA. It seamlessly integrates with the Competitive Companion browser extension to parse problems with a single click, generate solution files, and test your code in an interactive CPH/KHelper–style sidebar.

Key Features

  • One-Click Problem Parsing: Receives problem statements, metadata, and test cases directly from Competitive Companion (Codeforces, AtCoder, LeetCode, CodeChef, CSES, HackerRank, and 60+ online judges).
  • Interactive Test Runner (CPH Style): Clean, right-sidebar tool window with auto-expanding test cards, per-test run buttons, wall-clock execution timing, and status badges (PASS, FAIL, ERROR, TLE).
  • Live Editor Compilation: Runs tests directly from your active in-memory editor buffer — no need to spam Ctrl+S before running!
  • Zero-Clutter Architecture: Cleanly separates solution code in src/ while isolating all sample input/output files in a dedicated .cptests/ directory.
  • Auto-Sync Active Editor: Automatically detects and loads the test cases for whatever problem file is currently active in the editor tab.
  • Custom Test Cases: Easily add custom test cases with + Add Test Case or edit existing inputs/outputs with automatic disk synchronization.
  • Fully Customizable: Configure custom solution templates (with variables like ${PROBLEM_NAME}, ${DATE}, ${URL}, ${TIME_LIMIT}), output directories, listener ports, and file extensions.
  • Keyboard Shortcuts:
    • Ctrl+Shift+F10 — Run all test cases for current solution
    • Ctrl+Alt+N — Manually create a new CP solution file

Quick Start

  1. Install the Competitive Companion extension in your browser (Chrome / Firefox / Edge).
  2. Open your CP project in IntelliJ IDEA.
  3. Navigate to any problem on Codeforces, AtCoder, or other supported platforms and click the Competitive Companion green plus icon in your browser.
  4. Your solution file is immediately created and opened, and all sample test cases appear in the CP Tests sidebar on the right!
  5. Write your solution and press ▶ Run All to test your code!
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — Initial Release

  • Initial public release of MyCPAssistant on JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Full Competitive Companion integration on port 27121.
  • Interactive CPH-style right tool window with test cards, live execution timing, and status badges.
  • In-memory live editor compilation (no manual saving required).
  • Clean directory architecture with dedicated .cptests/ storage.
  • Automatic test case loading on tab switch or problem reopen.
  • Configurable code templates, paths, and port settings under Settings → Tools → Custom CP Companion.
